summary:
Caspian Eye is a smart coastal monitoring and climate resilience platform designed to track environmental changes along the Caspian Sea coast and the Kura River Delta in Azerbaijan using NASA–ISRO NISAR L-band Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR) data. Rapid water-level fluctuations, seasonal flooding, wetland (swamp) dynamics, and coastal land-cover changes pose growing ecological and socio-economic challenges, yet single satellite images fail to provide actionable insights.
​Caspian Eye solves this by converting multi-temporal satellite radar observations into clear, verifiable environmental indicators. Through automated geocoding, noise filtering, spatial clipping, and cross-date radar backscatter classification, the platform measures flooded areas and wetland shifts in square kilometers (km^2). An integrated AI layer translates complex scientific metadata, confidence levels, and classification metrics into human-readable reports and interactive GIS maps. By combining repeatable 12-day radar observations with optical validation, Caspian Eye empowers researchers, environmental agencies, and local decision-makers to monitor coastal dynamics accurately and respond proactively to climate-driven risks.
details:
Caspian Eye is an automated earth observation and climate resilience platform designed to monitor environmental shifts along the Caspian Sea and the Kura Delta using NASA–ISRO NISAR L-band SAR (Synthetic Aperture Radar) data.Key Features & Methodology:

1. Data Acquisition & Processing: Automatically sources open-access NISAR L-band radar data (24 cm wavelength) optimized for surface and vegetation tracking. Performs geocoding, noise filtering, and spatial clipping for precise regional analysis.

2. Change Detection & Metrics: Compares multi-temporal radar backscatters to identify flooding patterns, wetland (swamp) dynamics, and coastal land-cover variations, calculating exact areas in square kilometers (km^2).

3. Interactive Dashboard & AI Layer: Features a web interface (built via React/Next.js stack) displaying historical comparisons, GIS maps, and statistical variation reports. An integrated AI layer assists by translating complex radar metadata and confidence intervals into human-readable insights.

Tools, Technologies & Stack:

Data & Science: NASA–ISRO NISAR / Sentinel-1 SAR archives, GIS polygon mapping.

Innovation & Creativity: Combines 12-day repeat-cycle radar remote sensing with AI-driven explanatory metadata, bridging raw satellite telemetry with actionable environmental decision-making for local institutions in Azerbaijan.
